sections.thesis: French government bonds rallied, erasing roughly half of last week's losses, after Moody's held France's rating at Aa3 with a negative outlook.

sentences.text: French government bonds rallied, erasing roughly half of last week's losses, after Moody's held France's rating at Aa3 with a negative outlook.
The 10-year yield dropped 0.12 percentage points to 4.91%.
In the US, a $69BN 2-year auction tailed by 0.3bp ahead of this week's Fed decision, with foreign buyers taking just 45.7%, the lowest since November 2021.

sections.thesis: Brazil's real had its biggest fall since 1999 after President Lula's surprise re-election raised concerns over public debt and spending.

sentences.text: Brazil's real had its biggest fall since 1999 after President Lula's surprise re-election raised concerns over public debt and spending.
The real tumbled 8% against the US dollar to R$5.41.
Lula won 51.8% of the run-off vote against 48.2% for Flávio Bolsonaro, whom investors had hoped would tackle the budget deficit.
Investors now look to Lula's choice of finance minister.

sections.thesis: US tech stocks rose after Anthropic filed to go public, with chip and hardware stocks tied to the AI buildout rallying and the PHLX Semiconductor Index up 2.8%.

sentences.text: US tech stocks rose after Anthropic filed to go public, with chip and hardware stocks tied to the AI buildout rallying and the PHLX Semiconductor Index up 2.8%.
The S&P 500 rose 0.7% and the Nasdaq gained 0.8%.
Meta fell 1.9% after unveiling plans for up to $95 billion of stock offerings.

sections.thesis: Oil fell for a second straight session as diplomatic efforts involving Iran, Saudi Arabia, Turkey and Pakistan tempered fears of a broader regional escalation.

sentences.text: Oil fell for a second straight session as diplomatic efforts involving Iran, Saudi Arabia, Turkey and Pakistan tempered fears of a broader regional escalation.
December Brent futures fell 0.6% to $115.15 a barrel in Asian trading.
Iran said it is willing to reopen the Strait of Hormuz in four to seven days if the US lifts its blockade.
